description: Use when an agent needs to know if a stock exchange trades on a given day (default today) before scheduling orders, reports or alerts. 28 exchanges incl. NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE, Xetra, Euronext, SIX, Tokyo, HKEX, Shanghai, ASX. Returns holiday name, hours in local time + UTC, half days, lunch breaks, pre/after-market (Nasdaq, Xetra), live status, next open/close, previous/next trading day. Official exchange calendars only; bad input: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

date.description: Day as YYYY-MM-DD. Optional, default: today in the exchange's time zone.

exchange.description: Exchange MIC code, e.g. XNYS (NYSE), XNAS (Nasdaq), XLON (London), XETR (Xetra), XPAR (Paris), XTKS (Tokyo), XHKG (Hong Kong). Common names also work (NYSE, Xetra, LSE). Free list: GET /v1/exchanges.

title: Exchange Trading Calendar
